The snake's body is cylindrical and worm-like, lacking distinct patterning. The head is visible at the bottom left, appearing blunt and rounded, blending seamlessly into the neck. The tail end tapers naturally towards the right. The lighting highlights the smooth, slightly glossy texture of the scales against the rough, green-and-grey background.
